```{r}
#declare your api key here
api_key <- "27f3f6959deb2934d3f04ef434df400e8f9e8608"
# ============================================================
# Population by census region x sex x 5-year age group x year
# 2004–2020
#
# 2004–2009: Census API (2000/pep/int_charagegroups) via httr
# 2010–2019: Census API (2019/pep/charagegroups) via httr
# 2020:      tidycensus::get_estimates(product = "characteristics")
#
# Caching:
#   cache_dir/raw_2000_2009_YEAR.rds
#   cache_dir/raw_2010_2019_YEAR.rds
#   cache_dir/raw_2010_2020_YEAR.rds  (for 2020)
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(tidycensus)
  library(tigris)
  library(httr)
  library(jsonlite)
  library(stringr)
})

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# 0) user inputs
# -----------------------------
cache_dir <- "pep_cache"
years     <- 2004:2020

# -----------------------------
# 1) utilities
# -----------------------------
ensure_dir <- function(path) {
  if (!dir.exists(path)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE)
  invisible(path)
}

cache_get_or_set <- function(path, fn) {
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  ensure_dir(dirname(path))
  obj <- fn()
  saveRDS(obj, path, compress = "xz")
  obj
}

# JSON -> tibble (Census API returns [header, rows...])
census_json_to_tibble <- function(x) {
  header <- x[[1]]
  rows   <- x[-1]
  purrr::map_dfr(rows, function(r) {
    out <- as.list(r)
    names(out) <- header
    tibble::as_tibble(out, .name_repair = "unique")
  })
}

census_get_json_httr <- function(base_url, query_list, max_tries = 6, sleep_base = 0.8) {
  last_txt <- NULL
  for (i in seq_len(max_tries)) {
    resp <- try(GET(base_url, query = query_list), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(resp, "try-error")) {
      Sys.sleep(sleep_base * i)
      next
    }

    txt <- content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
    last_txt <- txt

    if (status_code(resp) >= 200 && status_code(resp) < 300) {
      # retry if truncated
      if (!str_ends(str_trim(txt), "]")) {
        Sys.sleep(sleep_base * i)
        next
      }
      parsed <- try(fromJSON(txt, simplifyVector = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(parsed, "try-error")) {
        Sys.sleep(sleep_base * i)
        next
      }
      return(parsed)
    }

    Sys.sleep(sleep_base * i)
  }

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Census API failed after retries.\n",
      "Last response: ", str_trim(str_sub(last_txt %||% "", 1, 400))
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 2) region crosswalk (state FIPS -> Census region)
# -----------------------------
make_state_region_lookup <- function() {
  # state.region is in base R (maps state name -> region); DC is not included
  region_by_abb <- tibble(
    state_abb = c(state.abb, "DC"),
    census_region = c(as.character(state.region), "South")
  )

  # tigris::fips_codes has state_code (FIPS) + state (abbrev)
  fips_lu <- tibble(tigris::fips_codes) %>%
    transmute(
      state_fips = str_pad(as.character(state_code), 2, pad = "0"),
      state_abb  = as.character(state)
    ) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(state_abb %in% c(state.abb, "DC"))

  fips_lu %>%
    left_join(region_by_abb, by = "state_abb")
}

state_region_lu <- make_state_region_lookup()

# -----------------------------
# 3) helpers for age/sex labels
# -----------------------------
age5_lookup_2000s <- function() {
  tibble(
    AGEGROUP = as.character(1:18),
    age5 = c(
      "0-4","5-9","10-14","15-19","20-24","25-29","30-34","35-39","40-44",
      "45-49","50-54","55-59","60-64","65-69","70-74","75-79","80-84","85+"
    )
  )
}

normalize_agegroup_label_to_age5 <- function(x) {
  # tidycensus AGEGROUP strings typically look like:
  # "Age 0 to 4 years", "Age 85 years and older", "All ages"
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))

  out[x == "Age 85 years and older"] <- "85+"

  idx <- is.na(out) & str_detect(x, "^Age\\s+\\d+\\s+to\\s+\\d+")
  if (any(idx)) {
    nums <- str_extract_all(x[idx], "\\d+")
    out[idx] <- purrr::map_chr(nums, ~ paste0(.x[1], "-", .x[2]))
  }

  out
}

# -----------------------------
# 4) 2000–2009 via Census API (int_charagegroups)
#    Fix for "too many predicates": only DATE_ is a predicate; RACE/HISP are columns.
# -----------------------------
build_date_map_int_charagegroups <- function(api_key) {
  base_url <- "https://api.census.gov/data/2000/pep/int_charagegroups"
  codes <- 1:12

  purrr::map_dfr(codes, function(cd) {
    q <- list(
      get = "DATE_DESC",
      `for` = "us:1",
      DATE_ = cd
    )
    if (nzchar(api_key)) q$key <- api_key

    out <- census_get_json_httr(base_url, q)
    df  <- census_json_to_tibble(out)

    tibble(code = cd, date_desc = as.character(df$DATE_DESC[1]))
  })
}

pick_date_code_for_july1 <- function(date_map, year) {
  target <- paste0("7/1/", year)
  hit <- date_map %>% filter(str_detect(date_desc, fixed(target)))
  if (nrow(hit) < 1) stop(paste0("No DATE_ code found for ", target), call. = FALSE)
  hit$code[1]
}

download_2000_2009_one_year <- function(year, api_key, cache_dir, date_map) {
  stopifnot(year >= 2000, year <= 2009)
  path <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0("raw_2000_2009_", year, ".rds"))

  cache_get_or_set(path, function() {
    base_url <- "https://api.census.gov/data/2000/pep/int_charagegroups"
    date_code <- pick_date_code_for_july1(date_map, year)

    q <- list(
      # include RACE and HISP as columns so we can filter totals locally
      get = "POP,AGEGROUP,SEX,RACE,HISP",
      `for` = "state:*",
      DATE_ = date_code
    )
    if (nzchar(api_key)) q$key <- api_key

    out <- census_get_json_httr(base_url, q)
    df  <- census_json_to_tibble(out)

    df %>%
      transmute(
        year = year,
        state_fips = str_pad(as.character(state), 2, pad = "0"),
        AGEGROUP = as.character(AGEGROUP),
        SEX = as.integer(SEX),
        RACE = as.integer(RACE),
        HISP = as.integer(HISP),
        pop = as.double(POP)
      )
  })
}

aggregate_2000_2009_to_region <- function(years_2000_2009_raw) {
  age5_lu <- age5_lookup_2000s()

  years_2000_2009_raw %>%
    # keep totals over race/hispanic origin
    filter(RACE == 0L, HISP == 0L) %>%
    filter(SEX %in% c(1L, 2L)) %>%
    filter(AGEGROUP %in% as.character(1:18)) %>%
    left_join(age5_lu, by = "AGEGROUP") %>%
    left_join(state_region_lu, by = "state_fips") %>%
    filter(!is.na(census_region)) %>%
    mutate(sex = if_else(SEX == 1L, "Male", "Female")) %>%
    group_by(year, census_region, sex, age5) %>%
    summarise(population = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# -----------------------------
# 5) 2010–2019 via Census API (2019/pep/charagegroups)
# -----------------------------
download_2010_2019_one_year <- function(year, api_key, cache_dir) {
  stopifnot(year >= 2010, year <= 2019)
  path <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0("raw_2010_2019_", year, ".rds"))

  cache_get_or_set(path, function() {
    base_url <- "https://api.census.gov/data/2019/pep/charagegroups"
    # DATE_CODE: 3 = 7/1/2010, 4 = 7/1/2011, …, 12 = 7/1/2019
    date_code <- year - 2010 + 3

    q <- list(
      get   = "POP,AGEGROUP,SEX",
      `for` = "state:*",
      DATE_CODE = date_code,
      RACE  = 0,
      HISP  = 0
    )
    if (nzchar(api_key)) q$key <- api_key

    out <- census_get_json_httr(base_url, q)
    df  <- census_json_to_tibble(out)

    df %>%
      transmute(
        year       = year,
        state_fips = str_pad(as.character(state), 2, pad = "0"),
        AGEGROUP   = as.integer(AGEGROUP),
        SEX        = as.integer(SEX),
        pop        = as.double(POP)
      )
  })
}

aggregate_2010_2019_to_region <- function(df) {
  age5_lu <- tibble(
    AGEGROUP = 1L:18L,
    age5 = c(
      "0-4","5-9","10-14","15-19","20-24","25-29","30-34","35-39","40-44",
      "45-49","50-54","55-59","60-64","65-69","70-74","75-79","80-84","85+"
    )
  )

  df %>%
    filter(SEX %in% c(1L, 2L)) %>%
    filter(AGEGROUP %in% 1L:18L) %>%
    left_join(age5_lu, by = "AGEGROUP") %>%
    left_join(state_region_lu, by = "state_fips") %>%
    filter(!is.na(census_region)) %>%
    mutate(sex = if_else(SEX == 1L, "Male", "Female")) %>%
    group_by(year, census_region, sex, age5) %>%
    summarise(population = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# -----------------------------
# 5b) 2020 via tidycensus
# -----------------------------
download_2020_one_year <- function(api_key, cache_dir) {
  path <- file.path(cache_dir, "raw_2010_2020_2020.rds")

  cache_get_or_set(path, function() {
    get_estimates(
      geography = "state",
      product = "characteristics",
      breakdown = c("SEX", "AGEGROUP"),
      breakdown_labels = TRUE,
      year = 2020,
      vintage = 2023,
      key = api_key
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        year = 2020L,
        state_fips = str_pad(as.character(GEOID), 2, pad = "0"),
        sex = as.character(SEX),
        agegroup_label = as.character(AGEGROUP),
        pop = as.double(value)
      )
  })
}

aggregate_2020_to_region <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(sex %in% c("Male", "Female")) %>%
    mutate(age5 = normalize_agegroup_label_to_age5(agegroup_label)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age5)) %>%
    left_join(state_region_lu, by = "state_fips") %>%
    group_by(year, census_region, sex, age5) %>%
    summarise(population = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# -----------------------------
# 6) main wrapper
# -----------------------------
estimate_population_region_sex_age5_by_year <- function(years, api_key, cache_dir = "pep_cache") {
  ensure_dir(cache_dir)
  years <- sort(unique(as.integer(years)))

  # 2004–2009 via Census API (int_charagegroups)
  y_2000_2009 <- years[years >= 2000 & years <= 2009]
  out_2000s <- tibble()
  if (length(y_2000_2009) > 0) {
    date_map <- build_date_map_int_charagegroups(api_key)
    raw_2000s <- purrr::map_dfr(
      y_2000_2009,
      ~ download_2000_2009_one_year(.x, api_key, cache_dir, date_map)
    )
    out_2000s <- aggregate_2000_2009_to_region(raw_2000s)
  }

  # 2010–2019 via Census API (charagegroups)
  y_2010_2019 <- years[years >= 2010 & years <= 2019]
  out_2010s <- tibble()
  if (length(y_2010_2019) > 0) {
    raw_2010s <- purrr::map_dfr(
      y_2010_2019,
      ~ download_2010_2019_one_year(.x, api_key, cache_dir)
    )
    out_2010s <- aggregate_2010_2019_to_region(raw_2010s)
  }

  # 2020 via tidycensus
  out_2020 <- tibble()
  if (2020L %in% years) {
    raw_2020 <- download_2020_one_year(api_key, cache_dir)
    out_2020 <- aggregate_2020_to_region(raw_2020)
  }

  bind_rows(out_2000s, out_2010s, out_2020) %>%
    arrange(year, census_region, sex, age5)
}

# -----------------------------
# 7) run
# -----------------------------
pop_region_sex_age5_year <- estimate_population_region_sex_age5_by_year(
  years = years,
  api_key = api_key,
  cache_dir = cache_dir
)

pop_region_sex_age5_year


pop_region_sex_age5_year |> write_csv("population_by_region_age_sex.csv")
```
